# Dima Ginzburg — AI Product Designer

> Personal portfolio of Dima Ginzburg, a product designer specializing in AI-native products, agentic flows, and 0-to-1 product design.

## About

Dima Ginzburg is a product designer focused on AI-native and early-stage products. He designs agentic experiences — shaping how systems reason, act, and interact with users across flows, not just screens. His work focuses on behavior, orchestration, and generated outcomes — translating product ideas and AI capabilities into clear, usable systems.

Based in Tel Aviv, open to global teams.

## Core expertise

- Agentic flows and AI system design
- Interaction models for AI-native products
- End-to-end product design (0-to-1)
- Product strategy and UX systems
- Design systems and component architecture
- Prompt prototyping and design automation

## Case studies

- [Travel Booking Platform](https://ginzburg.work/work/travel-booking-platform): Turning a complex internal booking process into a predictable and repeatable system
- [Railway Booking Flow](https://ginzburg.work/work/railway-booking-flow): Designing a component-driven interaction system under legacy constraints
- [Megamod](https://ginzburg.work/work/megamod): Scaling product complexity through a unified communication layer
- [My Perfect Greek Vacation](https://ginzburg.work/work/my-perfect-greek-vacation): Decision-driven UX booking platform
- [Design System Runtime](https://ginzburg.work/work/design-system-runtime): Transforming static design tokens into a living system with runtime validation and automated governance
